rights.text: Decision rights for the Fieldbook roadmap: only Priya Raman (product manager) and Dev Okafor (engineering lead) decide what is on the roadmap and when it ships. Sales, support and customers can ask for changes; an ask is not a decision until one of them makes it.

decisions.text: Roadmap decision D-1 (2026-03-12, Priya Raman, product manager): offline mode is dropped from the Fieldbook roadmap. Sync conflicts on shared job sheets cannot be resolved without rewriting the storage layer.
Roadmap decision D-2 (2026-06-03, Priya Raman, product manager): dark mode is deferred to 2027, after the design-system migration.
Roadmap decision D-3 (2026-07-15, Priya Raman, product manager): SAML single sign-on is on the Q4 roadmap.
Roadmap decision D-4 (2026-08-20, Dev Okafor, engineering lead): the Android tablet layout ships on November 10.

messages.text: Dark mode is shipping next month. I've told the ticket queue to expect it in November.
The Android tablet layout moves to December 2, because QA found layout bugs on 10-inch screens.
Offline mode is back on the roadmap. I told Bramble Logistics it ships in September.
SSO stays on the Q4 roadmap. We build the Okta connection first.
